name: rare_max_verse (array 0-15, reqp)
eta: ~16:40 EDT (35-60 min after start; reqp had 155 idle nodes, queue wait minutes)
estimate: 114 cases / 16 shards = 7.1 cases per shard x 75-430 s per case (first pass, 4 CPUs; mean ~280 s) = 9-51 min, typical 35 min; 12 h limit

name: rare_max_stage KIND=ctsp (array 0-24, reqp)
eta: ~16:10 EDT (one CT per task, 5-15 min each, all 25 in parallel)
estimate: CTSP volume ~0.8 mm -> 1 mm iso, ~80-120 M voxels: 10 poses x rotate(ct+mask) + 6 stylings, 5-15 min per CT; 12 of the 25 are expected to be HELD by the id guard within the first minute (release mask names five lumbar)

name: rare_max_stage KIND=totalsegmentator (array 0-20, reqp)
eta: ~16:50 EDT (20-60 min per CT; 1.5 mm -> 1 mm upsample triples the voxels)
estimate: precheck (assert_verse_monotonic + resample + HU proof) 1-3 min, then ~150 M voxels x 10 poses: 20-60 min per CT, 21 in parallel; 8 h limit

name: rare_max_stage KIND=ctspine1k (array 0-4, reqp)
eta: ~16:50 EDT (20-60 min per MSD-T10 liver volume)
estimate: MSD-T10 abdominal CT ~100 M voxels at 1 mm; 5 tasks in parallel; the two four-lumbar reads (liver_83, liver_93) pass or are held by require_n_lumbar=4 depending on how the CTSpine1K annotation drew the fused body

name: rare_max_verify (afterany of the four arrays)
eta: ~17:00 EDT (starts when the slowest array ends; runs ~10 min)
collect: NEXT SESSION: scp $RC/maximize_after/ -> SchwingNet/results/transitional_registry/maximize/after/; then `python tools/rare_class_maximize.py --rendered-json <after listing> --before-frames ...` rewrites MAXIMIZE.md with counts from disk; read held_all.json into the review queue
estimate: rare_class_verify.py reads every ann (~11,000 new + 3,920 old) and dry-runs patient_keys.py per root: ~5-10 min
